summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a routine Form 6-K with the SEC on October 1, 2026, attaching a press release covering its September 2026 delivery update. The company delivered 31,817 vehicles in September, bringing cumulative deliveries to 1,833,651 as of September 30, 2026, and reported 485 retail stores across 160 cities plus 4,188 super charging stations. The filing also notes October launches of the new Li i6 and a European debut at the Paris Motor Show. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, or deal terms are disclosed; this is an ordinary operational update with no special-situation characteristics.
